title: How Many Queens To BEAT Stockfish?
summary: Tony plays chess.com's 'Stockfish' rated 3200 (later revealed in another video to actually be Komodo). Game 1 even (he loses, the engine promotes). Round 2 he has one extra queen and wins, converting a pawn race into a queen mate.
rules: Game 1 even; add one extra queen per loss (replacing a pawn, as in the series).

opponent.name: Stockfish (chess.com 3200; actually Komodo per follow-up video)

setup: Game 1 standard; game 2 one White pawn replaced by a queen (which pawn not stated; h2 inferred from series).
current_impl_issues: Impl 'howmany' t=Q n=1 vs 3200: fine in concept but should start with 0 extra (even game) and replace a pawn rather than add on top; confirm pieces are added to the full army.
evidence: 0:01 'how many queens I need to beat stockfish rated 3200... game one no extra Queens'; 15:00 'round two one extra Queen'; 26:55 'Unstoppable Checkmate'. Placement of the extra queen not stated.
